expr: (async () => { const sl=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); const w=(ms)=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,ms)); const D=window.simDebug; sl[1].value='0.4'; sl[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); D.restart(); D.go(); await w(600); const a=window.simState.u; sl[1].value='2'; sl[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); D.restart(); D.go(); await w(600); const b=window.simState.u; sl[1].value='1'; sl[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return b/a; })()
note: speed is the pace only: nopea advances the heating 5 times as fast as hidas

expr: (() => { window.simAdapter.set({paluu: 'jäähdytys ensin', Qin: 750, p2: 60}); const S=window.simAdapter.get(); return S.paluu==='jäähdytys ensin' && S.Qin===750 && S.p2===60 && S.phase==='alku' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter set() writes the controls and resets the process

expr: (() => { window.simAdapter.reset(); const S=window.simAdapter.get(); return S.paluu==='sama paine' && S.Qin===500 && S.p2===100 && S.speed===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter reset() restores the defaults

expr: (() => { const L=window.simState.labels; let n=0; for (let i=0;i<L.length;i++){ const a=L[i]; if (a.x0<0||a.y0<0||a.x1>600||a.y1>400) n++; for (let j=i+1;j<L.length;j++){ const b=L[j]; if (a.x0<b.x1&&b.x0<a.x1&&a.y0<b.y1&&b.y0<a.y1) n++; } } return L.length>5 ? n : -1 })()
note: no label overlaps or clipping after the cycle (jäähdytys ensin, Q = 1000 J, p2 = 40 kPa)
